name: Cross-Session Knowledge Sync
description: Synchronizes knowledge across sessions via a shared Knowledge DAG with LCM-inspired hierarchical compression

classifierModel.description: Model used for fact extraction and classification

extractionEnabled.description: Whether to extract facts from turns

relevanceWindowHours.description: How far back to look for facts (hours)

maxInjectedTokens.description: Maximum tokens to inject as cross-session context

compressionThreshold.description: Number of d0 facts before triggering compression
